The vertical wooden lines in the background show slight waviness and inconsistent convergence, suggesting minor geometric instability in the depth rendering.
The front paws merge indistinctly into the white textured surface they are sitting on. The boundary between the paw toes and the blanket/nest is blurred, making the anatomy ambiguous.
